professionalSummary: Experienced Release Manager with 22 online banking channel releases through go-live weekends (2022‑2025), managing release calendar, go‑live checklist, post‑release watch, rollback execution, change advisory board readiness reviews, and residual risk documentation.
experienceHighlights: Managed 22 releases of the online banking channel, holding the release calendar and go‑live checklist throughout.
Ran post‑release watch with operations each go‑live weekend and executed two rollbacks when customer error rate on the login journey exceeded the agreed threshold.
Prepared every release through the change advisory board with documented readiness reviews and maintained approval references.
Recorded residual risks and hand‑over conditions for each release in release closure notes.
Served as release coordinator for two years prior to the Release Manager role, running the go‑live checklist under the previous manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Release calendar for 2024, go‑live checklist, change records for two rollbacks, and release closure notes for the last four releases, including change advisory board references.
